provenance: Independent source audit followed by direct reading and comparison of the immutable packet inputs on 2026-11-01. rationale: The dependency units establish Δ, S/O/V/ν, identities, slot lookup and temporary expression results. This unit defines Allocated and the two Live rules before WF and later theorems. Allocated is membership in object keys; Live starts at an occupied variable and follows occupied field entries. References concatenates every occupied variable slot and every occupied field occurrence, so equal identities in distinct slots count separately. WellFormed requires unique object/variable keys, a declared field list in exact order with Nodup fields, id.index < nextId, strictly older field targets, Nodup References and membership equivalence with Allocated. These exactly express the four authored conditions and exclude missing targets, duplicated ownership and cycles. WellFormedWith repeats those conditions while adding pending to References for uniqueness/coverage, supporting the text's separate accounting of temporary owners without claiming every intermediate storage alone is well formed.
limitations: This is a correspondence comparison of the frozen prose, exact selected statements/definitions, and identified semantic context. No Lean build, test execution, or proof-tactic audit was performed; compilation and evidence validation are separate checks.

Listed full-source context snapshots were consulted for the supporting declarations and example states discussed in the rationale and dependency comparisons; the listing does not claim examination of every unrelated proof or declaration in those files.
